data.title: 初音未来 · 唱片店
data.description: 【初音未来 · 唱片店】充满复古情调的黑胶唱片店内，换上时尚卫衣常服的初音未来戴着试听耳机，随着留声机流淌出的爵士旋律轻轻摇晃着小脑袋。她摘下一边耳机递到你的耳边——「Master 快听！这首老黑胶唱片的音质有一种非常特别的温暖感，能激发我好多好多创作灵感呢！」
data.action: 试听黑胶时将可移动耳罩向同行者侧转，另一手稳住耳机，分享声音
data.promptProse: At the record-shop listening station, Miku turns one swivel earcup toward her nearby listener while steadying the band with her other hand, keeping one ear covered. Her teal hoodie, dark skirt and opaque tights remain distinct beside the companion at the frame edge. The medium view includes turntable and record sleeve on the deck. Warm shop light reflects from vinyl grooves and headphone plastic, illuminating her friendly glance above shaded shelf rows.
